items.title: On GPS: Exclusive interview with Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella
items.summary: Artificial intelligence is fueling the American economy right now. But so much of the spending around AI is one massive bet – and many on Wall Street are worried about whether the payout will materialize. Fareed asks Satya Nadella, CEO of Microsoft, about the potential bubble and AI competition.
